newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE-Russia inflation quickens to 0.3 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Russia inflation quickens to 0.3 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have accelerated in the week ended July 28 to 0.3 percent from 0.2 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said.
If current price trends continue, monthly inflation for the whole of July will be 0.9 percent, the committee said. The monthly inflation rate in June was 1.1 percent.
If current price trends continue the inflation rate in the first seven months of 1997 will be 9.6 percent.
